data.question: Which of nine retained universe fixtures add demonstrable test coverage beyond pinned Nanoda/Arena suites, and what minimal reuse action is justified?
data.versions: Pinned source-only Git snapshots; nine exact NDJSON3.1.0 fixtures from completed screens; no checker execution.
data.commands: python3 explorations/runs/EXPLORE-UNIVERSE-CORPUS-REUSE-1/inventory.py; inspect exact archived source assertions and expectation metadata; retain one nine-case map.
data.sample: Exactly the six positive universe cases and three unique invalid variants; deduplicate unchanged P1/M1/I1 controls by SHA256. One source-only comparison; no checker/model/proof/mutant launch.
data.controls: Literal duplicate requires identical complete fixture bytes. Equivalent coverage requires a concrete assertion or expected-result test demanding the same behavior. Related helpers, production implementation, keyword matches and incidental library imports do not alone demonstrate the exact test obligation. Supported gap claims apply only to the inspected pinned snapshot/suite; external/generated content prevents global absence claims. Recommend the smallest useful subset with a named consumer/insertion point, or retain locally and stop universe expansion. A source-level gap is not a current bug or runtime fault-sensitivity result.
